components.name: Accent CTA
components.description: Primary hero action using authority navy and clear white contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background:#173B6C; color:#FFFFFF; min-width:150px; height:40px; padding:8px 24px; border:0; border-radius:4px; font:500 14px Roboto,sans-serif; transition:background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background:#0F294C; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #173B6C; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Submit CTA
components.description: High-confidence form action with AA text contrast.
components.css: .ds-btn-submit { background:#173B6C; color:#FFFFFF; height:45px; padding:8px 24px; border:0; border-radius:12px; font:500 14px Roboto,sans-serif; transition:background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-submit:hover { background:#0F294C; } .ds-btn-submit:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #173B6C; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Softly rounded contact input with an explicit focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; background:#FFFFFF; color:#111827; border:1px solid #D8DEE8; border-radius:16px; padding:8px 16px; font:400 16px Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #173B6C; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Image-led project surface with restrained framing.
components.css: .ds-project-card { color:#111827; font-family:Roboto,sans-serif; } .ds-project-media { min-height:180px; background:#F0F3F6; border-radius:16px; } .ds-project-card h3 { margin:16px 16px 8px; font-size:24px; line-height:1.3; } .ds-project-card p { margin:0 16px 16px; color:#5E6673; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Quiet, compact navigation that leaves visual priority to portfolio work.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; gap:32px; align-items:center; font:400 16px 'Barlow Semi Condensed',sans-serif; letter-spacing:1.3px; } .ds-nav a { color:#111827; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#173B6C; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #173B6C; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: A clean, light-first portfolio in which project imagery, generous whitespace, authority navy, and restrained brick signals communicate established product leadership without hype.

rules.name: The Navy Leads Rule
rules.body: Navy carries actions, links, focus, and primary emphasis; brick is reserved for identity signals and selected highlights.

rules.name: Flat by default
rules.body: Use shadow only to clarify layering, interaction, or a featured composition.

dos: Let project imagery provide the proof.
Let authority navy lead actions and focus.
Preserve generous whitespace and bilingual hierarchy.
donts: Do not turn brick into a competing primary action color.
Do not introduce gratuitous gradients or generic dashboard styling.
